steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until smooth.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute, then set it aside.
Pour in the eggs and cook undisturbed for 2 minutes, until the edges set.
Scatter the spinach and feta over one half.
Fold the omelette, cook 1 more minute, and slide it onto a plate.
